question: Oda-sensei, hello. Congratulations on reaching 1000 chapters!! By the way, was the color spread of Chapter 1000 made to look the same like the color spread for Chapter 100?! When I realized, I had non-stop goosebumps!! –
answer: That's exactly right~! Those who have been reading for a long time might've noticed, but those who joined along the way might have not realized. I tried to match them both as a commemoration.
name: Kino-san
